title: Weaver labels
description: The labels a card may carry, with the same words as the labels of the project where its issues live. Each key is the name of a family of labels, such as `type` or `area`. The writer labels a card with these values only.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for the editor.

family.description: The values of the family. Each key is a value, such as `bug`.

additionalProperties.description: What the value means, as it is told to the writer that chooses among them.
